decisions.summary: The judgment first: a glyph-check of the head race's mouth on Sawada, on main's map, rendered at 9 px per map unit over a 260 x 220 unit crop round the tap (4575, 3455), dispatched with the crop and the SVG; its verdict gates D2, and a not-the-river verdict closes 355 with no code.
decisions.why: FR-000 / SC-000 verbatim (glyph-check, Sawada, 9x, main's map, gate before any map change); the entry's sketch 'judge the new mouth at 9x ... first; only if the race still reads as the river'. The crop size and reading 9x as 9 px per map unit are execution detail. The trigger wording 'or as liable to be confused with it' is the glyph-check question FR-000 itself names ('can be confused with another'), not a widening of the sketch.

decisions.summary: Only if D1 says so: open_race_mouth appends race_taper to the race's bed - the race's own polyline cut at 30 ft, stroked at the race's own width with a userSpaceOnUse linearGradient from #9CB4C8 at the tap to SUPPLY_HUE; painted in the race's bed so the brook still covers the mouth; deterministic gradient id; a CONVENTION research claim.
decisions.why: FR-001 (first ~30 ft, brook hue to supply hue, along the race's own line), FR-002 (width untouched, only the hue), FR-003 (brook still paints over the mouth; a hamlet without a race mouth untouched, since the overlay is appended only where open_race_mouth finds a race), SC-001 (one gradient overlay of the first ~30 ft starting in the brook's hue), spec D1 / research R1 (map drawing convention). The id and the claim are implementation detail.

decisions.summary: Unit tests of race_taper and of open_race_mouth appending it; the pool re-rolled by the gate; the glyph-check the Occasions owe on the redrawn mouth after the gate.
decisions.why: Verification and enforcement of FR-001..FR-003 and SC-001/SC-002 (taper present, width unchanged, gate green); the post-gate glyph-check is the occasion feature 294 owes a redrawn glyph. No new map, tier or property is verified.
